newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World Infra in China power company deal.
newsitem.headline: New World Infra in China power company deal.

text.p: New World Infrastructure Ltd said late on Monday it had entered into an agreement with North China Power Group Co to acquire a 9.9 percent stake in Beijing Datang Power Generation Co Ltd for an undisclosed sum.

New World Infrastructure said in a statement that Beijing Datang, a subsidiary of North China Power Group, has proposed to be listed on both the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and London Stock Exchange in March.

The investment in Beijing Datang would increase New World Infrastructure power portfolio substantially from 1,470 MW to moe thant 4,600 MW, and its effective net ownership would increase from about 640 MW to as high as 950 MW, it said.
